name: Belize

findings.summary: State-controlled BTL picked Huawei as sole vendor for Belize's first nationwide 4G LTE network on DigiCell, about US$20m with 60 new cell sites; Huawei also trains staff and provides managed services.
findings.analyst_inference: Equipment vendor Huawei, so prc; Huawei's managed-services role strengthens control. Tier 3 (vendor award with value); launch was planned for December 2016 but operation at scale not confirmed in opened sources. US$20m is BTL's figure (BZ$40m, fixed 2:1 peg). Pre-2020 and still_current unconfirmed; a November 2023 Channel 5 report says BTL ordered new 2G-5G equipment without naming its vendor.

findings.summary: BTL contracted Huawei Marine to build SEUL, a 24 km, eight-fibre-pair submarine cable linking the Belize mainland to San Pedro (Ambergris Caye), with completion targeted for Q3 2017.
findings.analyst_inference: Huawei Marine (now HMN Tech) is the cable vendor, so prc. Tier 3 as an announced vendor partnership; completion not confirmed. SubTel Forum item likely relays a Huawei release. Value undisclosed. Pre-2020, still_current unchecked.

findings.local_actor: Government of Belize (Belize Integral Security Programme)
findings.financier: Central American Bank for Economic Integration (CABEI)
findings.summary: Government inaugurated 50 PTZ surveillance cameras across Belize City, first phase of a city emergency-response system under the CABEI-funded Belize Integral Security Programme; local firm Central TV and Internet holds the BZ$1.13m supply and maintenance contract.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole null: camera brand and software vendor are not named; the contractor is a Belizean integrator, not the equipment controller. US$ value from BZ$1,128,186.60 at the fixed 2:1 peg. San Pedro Sun appears to relay the press release, so independence is weak. Tier 5 as operational, though small (50 cameras).

findings.reversal_of: Belize Police facial-recognition partnership with Biometrica
findings.summary: Police put a facial-recognition agreement with Nevada-based Biometrica on hold because the system might require sending criminal databases to the company; talks continued, with police saying they may seek another vendor.
findings.analyst_inference: Pause, not cancellation. Tier 2 because whether a binding contract was signed is unclear. Reason coded regulatory (data-protection/law-enforcement data custody); could be read as data sovereignty or commercial. Not geopolitical, so it does not move the map. Outcome unknown.

findings.summary: Police Commissioner announced 1,000 surveillance cameras nationwide, focused on Belize City, with facial recognition, licence-plate reading and motion detection, to be installed from March 2025; vendor, financier and value not disclosed.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole null: no vendor named. Tier 1 as an official statement of intent; installation not confirmed. Possibly linked to the paused Biometrica facial-recognition deal (BLZ-004), unconfirmed.

facilities.null_reason: one search found no data-centre or AI-campus project; only a Bahamas-based Cloud Carib managed disaster-recovery service contract (2024) with no Belize facility named

silicon.null_reason: no dedicated search; no accelerator purchases surfaced in network, data-centre or AI searches
